_comment: Workflows whose failures should not notify anyone, one row per workflow.
A workflow that is known to fail turns notifications into noise, and noise
is how a notification channel stops being read. This is the escape hatch.
In the Bitable rather than the repository for the same reason as
ci_contacts: which backend is currently broken is operational state that
changes faster than code review, and whoever knows it is not always
whoever can land a PR.
Types: 1=text 5=datetime(ms since epoch).
workflow   the workflow's `name:` field, e.g. 'Xpu3.6-Build-And-Test',
NOT the file name. Same spelling as the lists in
auto-rerun.yml and notify-pr-owner.yml.
reason     why it is skipped. Required by convention rather than by the
schema: in six months this is the only thing that explains why
a backend went quiet.
until      when the skip expires. Once it is in the past the workflow
notifies again and the log says the entry is stale, so a skip
cannot be forgotten into permanence. Leave it empty for an
indefinite skip -- that is allowed, and warns every time, so
'forever' stays visible rather than becoming invisible.
added_by   who added it, for asking about it later.
